name: tachikoma
description: A conversation-first chatbot runtime built on pi-mono.

scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:protocol && bun run build:server && bun run build:cli && bun run build:desktop
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd packages/core clean && bun run --cwd packages/protocol clean && bun run --cwd packages/server clean && bun run --cwd packages/cli clean && bun run --cwd packages/desktop clean
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/protocol typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/server typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: bun test --preload ./packages/core/tests/offline-guard.ts packages/core/tests packages/protocol/tests packages/server/tests packages/cli/tests packages/desktop/tests --path-ignore-patterns '**/tests/live/**' --path-ignore-patterns '**/tests/package/**'
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run test:package && bun run test:pack && bun run audit
